name: CodeRAG-Bench
description: CodeRAG-Bench is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for retrieval-augmented code generation, covering basic programming, open-domain, and repository-level tasks. It assesses how retrieval of external contexts like documentation and code repositories can improve code generation models.
reputation: A recent arXiv benchmark that has started to be used in code-RAG papers, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Aggregates multiple sources for retrieval contexts; highlights challenges in retrieval and integration for code generation.
